_provenance: Mapping of Network Scope finding ids to control identifiers of three frameworks, for the compliance exports (export --format compliance-iec62443|compliance-nis2|compliance-cis). Only identifiers and short titles are used; no text of the standards is reproduced. The identifiers and titles were written from memory of the published documents (IEC 62443 foundational requirements FR 1 to FR 7; NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555 Article 21(2) points (a) to (j); CIS Critical Security Controls v8 safeguard numbers) and have not been compared with the licensed IEC text or the CIS workbook; check them before using an export as audit evidence. The assignment of a finding to a control is this project's own judgment of what the finding is evidence about, it is not an official crosswalk, and a scan can only observe what is reachable from the network. An export is an aid for preparing an assessment, not an assessment and not a certification.

evidence.note: Zone and conduit view: the asset list assigns each asset to a zone (see the method notes); industrial protocol ports reachable from the scanner are findings (ot-reachable).
Passive observation of control traffic (listen / OT capture) is reported as ot-control-traffic when present.

nis2.name: NIS2 Directive, Article 21(2) cybersecurity risk-management measures

controls.name: Risk analysis and information system security policies
Security in acquisition, development and maintenance, vulnerability handling
Assessing the effectiveness of risk-management measures
Basic cyber hygiene practices and training
Human resources security, access control and asset management

evidence.note: Asset management: this export is a dated inventory of the assets found by the scan (active and passive).
Repeated scans with a baseline (diff, monitor) show whether measures work over time.

cis.name: CIS Critical Security Controls v8 safeguards

controls.name: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
Use a Passive Asset Discovery Tool
Establish and Maintain a Software Inventory
Establish and Maintain a Secure Configuration Process
Manage Default Accounts on Enterprise Assets and Software
Uninstall or Disable Unnecessary Services on Enterprise Assets and Software
Establish and Maintain a Vulnerability Management Process
Establish and Maintain a Remediation Process
Perform Automated Vulnerability Scans of Internal Enterprise Assets
Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
Use of Secure Network Management and Communication Protocols

evidence.note: This export is the asset inventory: one row per device with addresses, MAC, vendor, type and OS.
Compare with an approved baseline (export of an earlier scan, diff --baseline) to find assets that are not on it.
The scan itself is an active discovery tool (ping, ARP, TCP/UDP probes).
Passive discovery (listen) adds assets without sending traffic; observations are included when present.
Unauthenticated, version-based checks only: CVE findings are hints, not confirmed vulnerabilities.
